name: AI Support Ticket Routing & Escalation System

parameters.content:
# AI Support Ticket Routing & Escalation System

Webhook -> Validation -> AI Classification -> Transform -> Category Branch -> DB Insert -> Priority Branch -> Emails -> Webhook Response

Complexity coverage:
- Conditional branching (category + priority)
- Data transformation (ticket_id, normalization, timestamps)
- AI integration (LiteLLM gpt-4o via OpenAI Chat Model)
- DB persistence (Supabase Postgres)
- Error handling branches (validation, DB, Gmail)
- Triggered execution (webhook)

Main path:
1) Validate payload + email format
2) AI classifies category/priority/summary
3) Normalize values
4) Branch on category + priority
5) Persist to Supabase tickets
6) Send escalation/customer emails
7) Return structured JSON to backend

Error handling branches:
- Validation failure -> 400 JSON
- DB insert failure -> 500 JSON
- Escalation Gmail failure -> 502 JSON
- Customer Gmail failure -> 502 JSON

All failures return structured JSON payloads.

priority
short_summary

Payment/refund/billing -> Billing
Login/system bug/error -> Technical
General questions -> General

Priority:

urgent, immediately, production down, blocked -> High
otherwise -> Medium

Support issue: ' + $json.issue }}
